questions.question: Monetary policy in South Africa is driven by:
options: The independent South African Reserve Bank

questions.question: The SARB pursues its constitutional mandate to protect the currency's value by keeping inflation:
options: Inside the target band of 3% to 6%

questions.question: The two great instruments of fiscal policy are:
options: The repo rate and the prime rate

questions.question: A policy that deliberately withdraws spending power to cool the economy is labelled:

subtopics.title: The SARB's Move — the Repo Rate

questions.question: Defined word-perfectly, the repo rate is the rate at which:
options: The government borrows from the SARB
The SARB lends to the commercial banks
Banks pay interest on savings accounts

questions.question: With inflation above the band, the SARB's expected move is to:
In the transmission mechanism, the prime lending rate rises because:
options: Banks recover their higher funding costs from customers

questions.question: The honest side effect of a repo increase that complete answers mention is:
options: It slows production and can cost jobs while it works

subtopics.title: The Minister's Toolbox — Two Fiscal Instruments

questions.question: Contractionary fiscal policy against inflation involves:
options: Restraining spending growth and/or raising taxes

questions.question: In a recession, the fiscal reverse gear is:
options: Accelerated public works, higher grants and lighter taxes — injecting demand

questions.question: 'The Minister of Finance raised the repo rate to curb inflation.' The defect in this statement is:
options: The repo rate cannot affect inflation
Inflation is only curbed by VAT
The repo rate belongs to the independent Reserve Bank, not the minister

questions.question: In the full anti-inflation scenario, the three moves — repo up, spending restrained, taxes up — share:
options: One contractionary direction, across two different drivers

subtopics.title: Comparing the Two Policies — and Answering Like an Economist

questions.question: The compressed comparison sentence from the lesson reads:
options: Monetary policy is fast but blunt; fiscal policy is slow but can be aimed
Fiscal policy is fast but blunt; monetary policy is slow but aimed
Both policies are equally fast and equally targeted

questions.question: A repo rate increase is felt first by:
options: Indebted households and leveraged firms — the bondholder within a month

questions.question: When the Reserve Bank tightens while government spends freely:
options: The treasury pumps in demand the Bank is draining, forcing the Bank to tighten even further
The repo rate loses all effect

subtopics.title: Two Drivers, Two Different Steering Wheels

questions.question: Applying 'whose hand is on it?', a grant increase announced in the Budget is:
options: Monetary policy, because grants are paid through banks
Monetary policy, because it changes the money supply
Fiscal policy — the minister's hand, through the Budget

questions.question: In the fire picture, which combination puts wood ON the fire?
options: Lighter taxes, bigger spending and cheaper loans

questions.question: The Reserve Bank's independence matters because:
options: It exempts the Bank from the Constitution
No politician can order a rate change before an election — unpopular decisions stay possible
It lets the Bank collect taxes

questions.question: The Reserve Bank's single obsession, put simply, is:
options: What your rand is worth — inflation held inside 3% to 6%

subtopics.title: How One Number in Pretoria Reaches Your Street

questions.question: The repo rate is charged when:
options: The Reserve Bank lends to Standard Bank, Absa, FNB, Nedbank or Capitec
A shop opens a store account

questions.question: The correct story order of the transmission chain is:
options: Repo up, taxes up, grants down, prices down
Repo up, prime down, borrowing up, inflation up
Repo up, prime up, repayments dearer, spending pulls in, price rises slow
Prime up, repo up, spending up, prices up

questions.question: The caterer decides against financing a second bakkie because:
options: Bakkies are taxed at the repo rate
At the higher rate, the repayments would swallow what the bakkie was meant to earn
The Reserve Bank refused her application

questions.question: Who hurts first while the rate medicine works?
options: The family with the bond — months before the debt-free family feels anything

subtopics.title: The Budget's Two Taps — Fast Tool, Slow Tool

questions.question: The minister's two taps are:
options: The repo rate and the exchange rate

questions.question: The broken sentence 'the Minister of Finance raises the repo rate' is answered completely by pointing out that:
options: The minister holds the taps, not the wheel — the repo rate is the Reserve Bank's
The repo rate should be lowered instead

questions.question: Fiscal policy is 'aimed' because it can:
options: Change the repo rate by province
Move faster than the Reserve Bank
Place a duty on luxury goods specifically, or steer spending to one programme or province

questions.question: If the treasury keeps pouring while the Bank is damping, the outcome is:
options: The taps and the wheel merge into one policy
The Bank damps harder — and borrowers pay the difference in higher instalments
